qwen3-8b.label: Qwen3 8B (MLX 4-bit)
qwen3-8b.note: Default. model_type 'qwen3', which mlx-lm implements. Text-only and trained for tool use. ~4.5GB leaves real headroom on 16GB.

qwen3-4b.label: Qwen3 4B (MLX 4-bit)
qwen3-4b.note: Step down if 8B is slow or memory is tight. Same architecture, so it loads the same way.
